messages:
alejandra: Quick sync — we need a short migration playbook for v1->v2 that covers: API URL changes, model pinning, SDK callsite diffs, and a fallback plan for model swaps. Goal: ship a concise guide + 3 snippets (js/py/ts) by EOD Friday.

tom: ok. I can PR the JS/TS snippets. Will mock the old v1 call and the v2 equivalent. any specific edgecases to show?

priya: include how to handle streaming framing differences and the new function-calling param. Also a note on rate limit headers — some customers saw 429 behavior change during canary.

alejandra: good call. add a short section: "When to pin model vs rely on routing" — 2 bullets.

max: i can do the Python snippet + a tiny script for swapping models w/ graceful fallback (tries preferred model, falls back to smaller variant). I'll add a comments block about tokens/latency tradeoffs.

docsbot: Reminder — docs site lint will fail on code fences missing language tag. Use ```javascript / ```python. Also run link-checker before PR.

tom: noted. i'll add tests in examples/ to make sure they run in CI.

priya: we should also update the deprecation blurb: keep it friendly, give timeline (announce -> soft-deprecate -> enforced), and link to migration guide. Draft copy: "We will deprecate v1 in 60 days; migrate to v2 for improved streaming, function-calling, and routing. See migration guide for examples."

alejandra: adjust to 90 days? legal asked for more runway for enterprise. 90 days ok?

max: 90 works.

alejandra: assign action items:
- tom: JS/TS snippets + PR by Thu noon
- max: Python snippet + fallback example by Thu EOD
- priya: deprecation blurb + streaming notes + link-check by Fri morning
- me: compile playbook, add timeline + badge, and get final signoff from legal/security

tom: tagging @max, @priya for visibility. I'll create branch docs/migration-playbook-171880 and push a WIP PR.

max: got it. i'll include a minimal dockerfile for the fallback script so customers can run locally.

priya: small nit — for the model-pin example, show both pinned model id and versioned alias, like `model: "gpt-redwood-1@v2.3"` and `model_alias: "gpt-redwood-1-stable"` so it's clear.

alejandra: yes please. also include a one-line curl example that shows new endpoint + header differences.

sre-oncall: FYI, if you mention fallback regions, include note about cross-region latency and data residency. Ops will want to review.

alejandra: noted; i'll loop ops on the PR.

docsbot: Action checklist: code snippets (js/py/ts), curl example, timeline banner, deprecation blurb, link-check, lint, ops/security signoff.

tom: WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3186 — still adding snippets.

max: PR looks good. added python example at the bottom, but left TODO for the dockerfile.

priya: pushed deprecation blurb to the PR. left a short example of streaming framing differences and a script to convert old frames to new. see snippet.

alejandra: awesome. i'll review tonight. if everything's green, we can schedule the deprecation announcement for next Tue and include the migration playbook link.

priya: quick preflight — do we want a customer-facing changelog item or an in-app banner? both?

tom: both. banner + changelog entry in the release notes page. banner should link to playbook.

max: also add a troubleshooting FAQ bullet: "Common cause: missing function schema in v2 -> errors during call" with sample error and fix.

alejandra: perfect. thanks team. last step: when PR is ready, add the internal label `needs-ops-review` and request reviews from @sre-oncall and @security.

sre-oncall: will review once labeled. thanks for tagging.

alejandra: closing loop here — expected final merge Fri evening, announcement Tue. Will update this thread with PR numbers and announcement copy.
